collection.name: ESS-MAI Executable Prior Art — POC Collection
collection.author: Bledar Gjata

policy.terminology: Every published theory or system capsule is a POC, never a demo.
policy.evidence: C01 and C02 are reference-only and are not evidence.
policy.advancement_method: experimental success + experimental failure = architecture-preserving advancement method
policy.claim_boundary: Each POC establishes only claims supported by its own disclosed artifacts and reproducible procedure.
policy.authority_root: GCL is the sovereign constitutional parent; subordinate platform authorities remain bounded.
policy.parallel_knowledge: Constructive K+ and rigorous-negative K- are distinct sibling outcomes under GCL; HOLD is neither; both verified knowledge streams advance later cycles by different operations.

entries.runs: 3/3 empty cold-start gap reproduced; 1/1 exact-pair positive control passed

entries.runtime: one post-authorization result; seven concurrent copied-handle replays refused

entries.native_tests: separate runs: 12/12, 19/19, 1/1; four focused verdict filters each 1/1 (overlap not summed)
entries.runtime: valid re-entry hard-blocks the known failure; corrupt, missing, and downgraded required history refuse PRO
entries.parallel_knowledge: source-evidenced Constructive -> Primitive (K+) and RigorousNegative -> Negative (K-); POC-006 executes only the K- re-entry half

exclusions: targets, caches, binaries, archives, WAL/vault/hold files
credentials, private keys, tokens, environment dumps, private absolute paths
unissued DOI, tag, release, archive, or timestamp claims
